exposure: depletion of Bifidobacterium after prolonged labor
higher Enterobacteriaceae/Bacteroidaceae ratios and Clostridioides difficile colonization at 12 months
finding: Pathways from cesarean birth and first pregnancy to child overweight and atopy share several common infant gut microbiome mediators, particularly C. difficile colonization.
mod_finding: After both cesarean birth and prolonged labor with a first pregnancy, a higher Enterobacteriaceae/Bacteroidaceae ratio at 3 months was the dominant path to overweight.
